.github/workflows/ndu-port-candidate.yml.utf8:
name: NDU dependency port candidate

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/ndu-port-candidate.yml
      - scripts/ndu_port_candidate.py
      - scripts/ndu_port_candidate_common.py
      - scripts/ndu_port_matrix_fixture.py
      - scripts/ndu_port_aws_upstream.py
      - scripts/test_ndu_port*.py
      - experiments/multimodal_output_portfolio/closure_v2_20261027/ci/port-remediation/**
      - experiments/multimodal_output_portfolio/closure_v2_20261027/ci/matrix-remediation/**
      - codex-rs/third_party/**
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ndu-port-candidate-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: 1
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: 2
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
  CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: 0
  CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: 0

jobs:
  generate-reviewable-candidate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    outputs:
      source_commit: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.source_commit }}
      result_sha256: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.result_sha256 }}
      artifact_name: ndu-port-candidate-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact reviewed new source
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Test source binding, phase evidence and failure preservation
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_ndu_port*.py' -v

      - name: Prepare pinned Bazel tooling
        uses: ./.github/actions/prepare-bazel-ci
        with:
          target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          cache-scope: ndu-port-candidate

      - name: Install explicit candidate compiler
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@d86e0fa8f147d6539442c26a61ebba8becc19489
        with:
          toolchain: 1.96.0

      - name: Verify recipe and generate source plus both locks
        id: generate
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/ndu_port_candidate.py --mode generate
          --repository "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --expected-source "$EXPECTED_SOURCE"
          --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ndu-port-candidate"

      - name: Retain complete or partial producer evidence
        if: always() && !cancelled()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@bbbca2ddaa5d8feaa63e36b76fdaad77386f024f
        with:
          name: ndu-port-candidate-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ndu-port-candidate
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 21
          include-hidden-files: true

  produce-independent-matrix-018-fixture:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    outputs:
      result_sha256: ${{ steps.produce.outputs.result_sha256 }}
      artifact_name: ndu-matrix-018-fixture-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out the new driver and reviewed fixture patch
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: driver
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Independently check out the fixed original source and 0.18 lock
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: 6215cb6a87f29623d4beaad24cdf7bcb6bb4fb2c
          path: baseline
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: ./driver/.github/actions/setup-ci

      - name: Install Linux build prerequisites
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -y
          sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config libcap-dev bubblewrap

      - name: Install explicit original compiler
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@e081816240890017053eacbb1bdf337761dc5582
        with:
          toolchain: 1.95.0

      - name: Install normal CI nextest version
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@44c6d64aa62cd779e873306675c7a58e86d6d532
        with:
          tool: nextest
          version: 0.9.103

      - name: Produce and seal actual old-version state using only the fixture patch
        id: produce
        env:
          EXPECTED_DRIVER_SOURCE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          CODEX_REPO_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/baseline
          CARGO_TARGET_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/ndu-matrix-018-target
        run: >-
          python3 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/driver/scripts/ndu_port_matrix_fixture.py"
          --repository "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/baseline"
          --driver-repository "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/driver"
          --expected-driver-source "$EXPECTED_DRIVER_SOURCE"
          --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ndu-matrix-018-fixture"

      - name: Retain original source, lock, executable, database files and failures
        if: always() && !cancelled()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@bbbca2ddaa5d8feaa63e36b76fdaad77386f024f
        with:
          name: ndu-matrix-018-fixture-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ndu-matrix-018-fixture
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 21
          include-hidden-files: true

  targeted-workspace-tests:
    needs: generate-reviewable-candidate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        group: [yaml, aws, keyring]
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact producer source
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.generate-reviewable-candidate.outputs.source_commit }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-ci

      - name: Install Linux build prerequisites
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -y
          sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config libcap-dev bubblewrap

      - name: Install explicit candidate compiler
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@d86e0fa8f147d6539442c26a61ebba8becc19489
        with:
          toolchain: 1.96.0

      - name: Install normal CI nextest version
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@44c6d64aa62cd779e873306675c7a58e86d6d532
        with:
          tool: nextest
          version: 0.9.103

      - name: Download the one producer artifact from this run
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: ${{ needs.generate-reviewable-candidate.outputs.artifact_name }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ndu-port-candidate

      - name: Verify exact source and artifacts then run actual workspace packages
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ needs.generate-reviewable-candidate.outputs.source_commit }}
          EXPECTED_RESULT_SHA256: ${{ needs.generate-reviewable-candidate.outputs.result_sha256 }}
          TEST_GROUP: ${{ matrix.group }}
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/ndu_port_candidate.py --mode test
          --repository "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --expected-source "$EXPECTED_SOURCE"
          --candidate "$RUNNER_TEMP/ndu-port-candidate" --expected-result-sha256 "$EXPECTED_RESULT_SHA256"
          --group "$TEST_GROUP" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ndu-port-tests-$TEST_GROUP"

      - name: Retain every attempted regression and failure
        if: always() && !cancelled()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@bbbca2ddaa5d8feaa63e36b76fdaad77386f024f
        with:

          retention-days: 21

  matrix-workspace-and-old-fixture:

    timeout-minutes: 180
    steps:

      - name: Install explicit candidate compiler

        with:
          tool: nextest
          version: 0.9.103

      - name: Download the same candidate
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: ${{ needs.generate-reviewable-candidate.outputs.artifact_name }}

      - name: Download the independent old-source fixture from this run
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c
        with:
          name: ${{ needs.produce-independent-matrix-018-fixture.outputs.artifact_name }}

justfile.utf8:
set working-directory := "codex-rs"
set positional-arguments
export CODEX_REPO_ROOT := justfile_directory()
export JUST_SHELL := justfile_directory() / "scripts/just-shell.py"
set shell := ["python3", "-c", 'import os, runpy; runpy.run_path(os.environ["JUST_SHELL"], run_name="__main__")']
set windows-shell := ["python", "-c", 'import os, runpy; runpy.run_path(os.environ["JUST_SHELL"], run_name="__main__")']

rust_min_stack := "8388608" # 8 MiB
python := if os_family() == "windows" { "python" } else { "python3" }

# Display help
help:
    just -l

# `codex`
alias c := codex
codex *args:
    cargo run --bin codex -- {args}

# `codex exec`
exec *args:
    cargo run --bin codex -- exec {args}

# Start `codex exec-server` and run codex-tui.
[no-cd]
[positional-arguments]
[unix]
tui-with-exec-server *args:
    {{ justfile_directory() }}/scripts/run_tui_with_exec_server.sh "$@"

# Run the CLI version of the file-search crate.
file-search *args:
    cargo run --bin codex-file-search -- {args}

# Run the standalone code-mode host from source.
code-mode-host *args:
    cargo run --bin codex-code-mode-host -- {args}

# Assemble a local Codex package.
[no-cd]
assemble-codex-package *args:
    {{ python }} {{ justfile_directory() }}/scripts/build_codex_package.py {args}

# Build the CLI and run the app-server test client
app-server-test-client *args:
    cargo build -p codex-cli
    cargo run -p codex-app-server-test-client -- --codex-bin ./target/debug/codex {args}

# Format changed files with their owning language tools. Use `just fmt --all` for the full tree.
fmt *args:
    @{{ python }} ../scripts/format.py {args}

# Check the entire repository without modifying files; never silently check an empty diff.
fmt-check:
    @{{ python }} ../scripts/format.py --all --check

fix *args:
    cargo clippy --fix --tests --allow-dirty {args}

clippy *args:
    cargo clippy --tests {args}

[unix]
install:
    rustup show active-toolchain
    cargo fetch

[windows]
install:
    #!powershell.exe -File
    $pwsh = Get-Command pwsh.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $pwsh) {
        winget install --exact --id Microsoft.PowerShell --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
    }
    rustup show active-toolchain
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
    cargo fetch
    exit $LASTEXITCODE

# Run nextest with --no-fail-fast so all tests are run.
#
# Run `cargo install --locked cargo-nextest` if you don't have it installed.
# Scoped workspace packages use fresh manifest metadata; Cargo still compiles
# all requested targets/features. Graph filters and full runs use full metadata.
# Set HEPTA_NEXTTEST_FULL_METADATA=1 to force the normal nextest metadata path.
[unix]
test *args:
    RUST_MIN_STACK={{ rust_min_stack }} NEXTEST_PROFILE=local {{ python }} ../scripts/run-nextest.py "$@"

[windows]
test *args:
    $env:RUST_MIN_STACK = "{{ rust_min_stack }}"; $env:NEXTEST_PROFILE = "local"; {{ python }} ../scripts/run-nextest.py @($args | Select-Object -Skip 1)

# Run from the repository root so scripts that resolve paths from `cwd` see
# the same layout they use in GitHub Actions.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cross-platform shell launcher for `just` recipes.

This keeps recipe bodies as normal shell snippets while giving the justfile one
portable placeholder, `{args}`, for forwarding variadic recipe arguments.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys


ARGS_TOKEN = "{args}"
STDERR_NULL_TOKEN = "{stderr-null}"
POWERSHELL_ARGS = "@($args | Select-Object -Skip 1)"
POWERSHELL_STDERR_NULL = "2>$null; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
SH_ARGS = '"$@"'
SH_STDERR_NULL = "2>/dev/null"


def main() -> int:
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("just shell adapter expected a recipe command.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    command = sys.argv[1]
    recipe_name = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else ""
    recipe_args = sys.argv[3:]

    if os.name == "nt":
        return run_powershell(command, recipe_name, recipe_args)
    else:
        return run_sh(command, recipe_name, recipe_args)


def run_sh(command: str, recipe_name: str, recipe_args: list[str]) -> int:
    command = command.replace(ARGS_TOKEN, SH_ARGS)
    command = command.replace(STDERR_NULL_TOKEN, SH_STDERR_NULL)
    os.execvp("sh", ["sh", "-cu", command, recipe_name, *recipe_args])


def run_powershell(command: str, recipe_name: str, recipe_args: list[str]) -> int:
    pwsh = shutil.which("pwsh.exe") or shutil.which("pwsh")
    if pwsh is None:
        print(
            "PowerShell ('pwsh') is required for Windows just recipes. "
            "Run 'just install' to install it.",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 1

    command = command.replace(ARGS_TOKEN, POWERSHELL_ARGS)
    command = command.replace(STDERR_NULL_TOKEN, POWERSHELL_STDERR_NULL)
    return subprocess.run(
        [
            pwsh,
            "-NoLogo",
            "-NoProfile",
            "-CommandWithArgs",
            command,
            recipe_name,
            *recipe_args,
        ],
        check=False,
    ).returncode


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate or qualify one source-bound dependency port without promotion."""

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

from ndu_port_candidate_common import LOCKS
from ndu_port_candidate_common import POLICIES
from ndu_port_candidate_common import RECIPE
from ndu_port_candidate_common import Recorder
from ndu_port_candidate_common import changed_paths
from ndu_port_candidate_common import check_checkout
from ndu_port_candidate_common import check_toolchain
from ndu_port_candidate_common import checksum
from ndu_port_candidate_common import copy_files
from ndu_port_candidate_common import describe
from ndu_port_candidate_common import load_candidate
from ndu_port_candidate_common import load_recipe
from ndu_port_candidate_common import patch_paths
from ndu_port_candidate_common import restore_candidate
from ndu_port_candidate_common import validate_graph
from ndu_port_candidate_common import verify_tree
from ndu_port_candidate_common import verify_vendor


TEST_GROUPS = {
    "yaml": (
        "codex-utils-yaml",
        "codex-skills",
        "codex-skills-extension",
        "codex-core-plugins",
        "codex-external-agent-migration",
    ),
    "aws": ("codex-aws-auth", "codex-login", "codex-secrets"),
    "keyring": ("codex-keyring-store",),
    "matrix": (
        "codex-hepta-matrix-protocol",
        "codex-hepta-matrix-store",
        "codex-hepta-matrix-sdk",
        "codex-hepta-matrixd",
    ),
}
BAZEL_TARGETS = (
    "//codex-rs/utils/yaml:yaml",
    "//codex-rs/aws-auth:aws-auth",
    "//codex-rs/keyring-store:keyring-store",
    "//codex-rs/hepta-matrix-sdk:hepta-matrix-sdk",
    "//codex-rs/third_party/serde-saphyr-2.0.0:serde-saphyr",
    "//codex-rs/third_party/aws-config-1.8.12:aws-config",
    "//codex-rs/third_party/keyring-3.6.3:keyring",
    "//codex-rs/third_party/secret-service-4.0.0:secret-service",
    "//codex-rs/third_party/matrix-sdk-0.19.1:matrix-sdk",
    "//codex-rs/third_party/matrix-sdk-sqlite-0.19.1:matrix-sdk-sqlite",
)


def generate(runner, expected_source):
    check_checkout(runner, expected_source)
    recipe = load_recipe(runner.root)
    runner.record.update(
        recipe_sha256=checksum(runner.root / RECIPE),
        policy_inputs=describe(runner.root, POLICIES),
        lock_inputs=describe(runner.root, LOCKS),
    )
    shutil.copyfile(runner.root / RECIPE, runner.output / "recipe.json")
    shutil.copyfile(runner.root / recipe["patch_path"], runner.output / "source.patch")
    patch = runner.output / "source.patch"
    if patch_paths(runner, patch) != set(recipe["allowed_paths"]):
        raise ValueError(
            "Source patch path set differs from the exact recipe allowlist"
        )
    runner.run("check-source-patch", ["git", "apply", "--check", "--index", str(patch)])
    runner.run("apply-source-patch", ["git", "apply", "--index", str(patch)])
    fixed_source = describe(runner.root, recipe["allowed_paths"], allow_missing=True)
    verify_vendor(runner.root, recipe)
    check_toolchain(runner, "1.96.0")
    runner.run("bazel-version", ["bazel", "--version"])
    manifest = str(runner.root / "codex-rs/Cargo.toml")
    for index, update in enumerate(recipe["cargo_updates"]):
        command = [
            "cargo",
            "update",
            "--manifest-path",
            manifest,
            "--package",
            update["package"],
        ]
        if "precise" in update:
            command.extend(["--precise", update["precise"]])
        runner.run(f"cargo-update-{index}", command)
    metadata_command = [
        "cargo",
        "metadata",
        "--manifest-path",
        manifest,
        "--locked",
        "--format-version",
        "1",
    ]
    metadata = runner.json_command("metadata-before-bazel", metadata_command)
    validate_graph(runner.root, recipe, metadata)
    runner.run("bazel-lock-update", ["just", "bazel-lock-update"])
    runner.run("bazel-lock-check", ["just", "bazel-lock-check"])
    metadata = runner.json_command("metadata", metadata_command)
    runner.run("diff-check", ["git", "diff", "--check", "HEAD"])
    if (
        describe(runner.root, recipe["allowed_paths"], allow_missing=True)
        != fixed_source
    ):
        raise ValueError("A resolver modified the reviewed source patch")
    validate_graph(runner.root, recipe, metadata)
    changed = changed_paths(runner)
    if not set(recipe["allowed_paths"]) <= changed or not changed <= set(
        (*recipe["allowed_paths"], *LOCKS)
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Resolved candidate differs from the approved source/lock scope"
        )
    inventory = describe(
        runner.root, (*recipe["allowed_paths"], *LOCKS), allow_missing=True
    )
    copy_files(runner.root, runner.output / "files", inventory)
    runner.record.update(files=inventory, changed_paths=sorted(changed))
    verify_tree(runner, runner.record, recipe)
    complete_patch = runner.output / "candidate.patch"
    runner.run(
        "export-candidate-patch",
        [
            "git",
            "diff",
            "--binary",
            "--full-index",
            "--no-renames",
            f"--output={complete_patch}",
            "HEAD",
        ],
    )
    if patch_paths(runner, complete_patch) != changed:
        raise ValueError("Exported complete binary patch has a different file set")
    runner.record.update(
        artifacts=describe(
            runner.output,
            (
                "recipe.json",
                "source.patch",
                "candidate.patch",
                "metadata-before-bazel.json",
                "metadata.json",
            ),
        ),
        status="candidate_generated",
        qualification="Only source/graph/Cargo/Bazel lock generation. Tests, unchanged cargo-deny and platform gates remain separate.",
    )


def junit_inventory(runner):
    directory = Path(
        os.environ.get("CARGO_TARGET_DIR", runner.root / "codex-rs/target")
    )
    if not directory.is_absolute():
        directory = runner.root / "codex-rs" / directory
    return {
        path: (path.stat().st_mtime_ns, checksum(path))
        for path in directory.glob("nextest/*/junit.xml")
    }


def workspace_tests(runner, record, recipe, group):
    runner.run("nextest-version", ["cargo", "nextest", "--version"])
    runner.record.update(test_group=group, test_results=[])
    failures = []
    for package in TEST_GROUPS[group]:
        before = junit_inventory(runner)
        status = runner.run(
            f"test-{package}",
            ["just", "test", "--locked", "--cargo-profile", "ci-test", "-p", package],
            required=False,
        )
        outcome = {
            "package": package,
            "exit_code": status,
            "command_index": len(runner.record["commands"]) - 1,
            "junit": [],
        }
        for path, description in junit_inventory(runner).items():
            if before.get(path) != description:
                target = runner.output / f"{package}-{path.parent.name}-junit.xml"
                shutil.copyfile(path, target)
                outcome["junit"].append(
                    {"file": target.name, "sha256": checksum(target)}
                )
        runner.record["test_results"].append(outcome)
        if status:
            failures.append(package)
        verify_tree(runner, record, recipe)
        runner.save()
    return failures


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--mode",
        choices=("generate", "test", "restore", "verify", "bazel", "upstream-aws"),
        required=True,
    )
    parser.add_argument("--repository", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--candidate", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-result-sha256")
    parser.add_argument("--group", choices=TEST_GROUPS)
    parser.add_argument("--old-fixture", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-old-result-sha256")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    runner = Recorder(args.repository, args.output, args.mode)
    success = False
    try:
        if args.mode == "generate":
            generate(runner, args.expected_source)
            success = True
        else:
            if not args.candidate or not args.expected_result_sha256:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Consumer requires the bound producer artifact and result SHA"
                )
            if args.mode == "verify":
                record, recipe = load_candidate(
                    runner,
                    args.candidate,
                    args.expected_result_sha256,
                    args.expected_source,
                )
                verify_tree(runner, record, recipe)
                runner.record.update(
                    source_commit=args.expected_source,
                    candidate_result_sha256=args.expected_result_sha256,
                    recipe_sha256=record["recipe_sha256"],
                )
            else:
                record, recipe = restore_candidate(
                    runner,
                    args.candidate,
                    args.expected_result_sha256,
                    args.expected_source,
                )
            check_toolchain(runner, "1.96.0")
            if args.mode == "upstream-aws":
                from ndu_port_aws_upstream import qualify_aws

                try:
                    success = qualify_aws(runner, recipe)
                finally:
                    verify_tree(runner, record, recipe)
                runner.record["status"] = (
                    "full_upstream_aws_passed"
                    if success
                    else "full_upstream_aws_failed"
                )
            elif args.mode == "bazel":
                runner.run("bazel-version", ["bazel", "--version"])
                status = runner.run(
                    "bazel-candidate-libraries",
                    [
                        "bazel",
                        "build",
                        "--config=ci-bazel",
                        "--platforms=//:local_linux",
                        "--lockfile_mode=error",
                        *BAZEL_TARGETS,
                    ],
                    required=False,
                )
                verify_tree(runner, record, recipe)
                runner.record.update(
                    status="bazel_build_failed" if status else "bazel_libraries_built",
                    bazel_targets=BAZEL_TARGETS,
                    bazel_exit_code=status,
                    qualification="Linux library and first-party consumer builds only; not all-platform or full-workspace tests.",
                )
                success = status == 0
            elif args.mode == "test":
                if not args.group:
                    raise ValueError("A test group is required")
                failures = workspace_tests(runner, record, recipe, args.group)
                if args.group == "matrix":
                    if not args.old_fixture or not args.expected_old_result_sha256:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Matrix tests also require the independent old-version artifact"
                        )
                    from ndu_port_matrix_fixture import consume_old_fixture

                    try:
                        consume_old_fixture(
                            runner,
                            recipe,
                            args.old_fixture,
                            args.expected_old_result_sha256,
                            args.expected_source,
                        )
                    except Exception as error:
                        runner.record["matrix_migration_error"] = {
                            "type": type(error).__name__,
                            "message": str(error),
                        }
                        failures.append("old-version-fixture-reopen")
                    verify_tree(runner, record, recipe)
                runner.record.update(
                    status="tests_failed" if failures else "targeted_tests_passed",
                    failed_tests=failures,
                )
                success = not failures
            else:
                runner.record["status"] = (
                    "candidate_restored"
                    if args.mode == "restore"
                    else "candidate_verified_unchanged"
                )
                success = True
    except Exception as error:
        runner.record.update(
            status="failed", error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error)
        )
        if args.mode == "generate":
            try:
                recipe = load_recipe(runner.root)
                partial = describe(
                    runner.root, (*recipe["allowed_paths"], *LOCKS), allow_missing=True
                )
                copy_files(runner.root, runner.output / "partial-files", partial)
                runner.record["partial_files"] = partial
                runner.record["original_dependency_policy_unchanged"] = describe(
                    runner.root, POLICIES
                ) == runner.record.get("policy_inputs")
            except Exception as snapshot_error:
                runner.record["partial_snapshot_error"] = str(snapshot_error)
    finally:
        runner.save()
    if success and args.mode == "generate" and os.environ.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT"):
        with Path(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"]).open("a") as stream:
            stream.write(f"source_commit={runner.record['source_commit']}\n")
            stream.write(f"result_sha256={checksum(runner.output / 'RESULT.json')}\n")

def verify_old_packages(lock):
    packages = tomllib.loads(lock.read_text())["package"]
    for name in OLD_PACKAGES:
        versions = [row["version"] for row in packages if row["name"] == name]

                f"Old fixture must resolve exactly {name} 0.18.0, got {versions}"

def parse_phase_junit(path, expected):
    report = ET.parse(path).getroot()
    cases = list(report.iter("testcase"))
    if len(cases) != 1 or cases[0].get("name") != expected:
        raise ValueError("The exact migration test must be the only executed testcase")
    if cases[0].get("classname") != "codex-hepta-matrix-sdk::store_version_migration":
        raise ValueError("Migration testcase came from a different test binary")
    rejected = {
        "failure",
        "error",
        "skipped",
        "flakyFailure",
        "flakyError",
        "rerunFailure",
        "rerunError",
    }
    if any(node.tag in rejected for node in report.iter()):
        raise ValueError("Skipped, failed or retried migration tests are not a pass")
    if report.get("tests") != "1" or any(
        int(report.get(name, "0")) for name in ("failures", "errors", "skipped")
    ):
        raise ValueError("Migration requires one executed pass and no failures/skips")

def run_phase(runner, name, fixture):

        "ci-test",

        "store_version_migration",
        "--tool-config-file",

        f"{name}-binaries",

            "cargo",
            "nextest",

            "--list-type",
            "binaries-only",

            "json",

    )

        len(binaries) != 1
        or binaries[0]["binary-name"] != "store_version_migration"
        or binaries[0]["kind"] != "test"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected exactly the actual migration test executable")

    if binary.is_symlink() or not binary.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Migration executable is not a regular compiled file")

        raise ValueError("Saved executable differs from the compiled binary")

    reports = lambda: {
        path: (path.stat().st_mtime_ns, checksum(path))

            "test",

            "--profile",
            "default",

            "only",

        "nextest_storage": storage,

        )[storage["config_file"]] == storage["config"],
    }
    runner.record["migration_phase"] = phase
    fresh = [path for path, value in reports().items() if before.get(path) != value]
    phase["fresh_junit_count"] = len(fresh)
    phase["observed_junit_paths"] = [str(path) for path in fresh]
    for index, path in enumerate(fresh):
        shutil.copyfile(path, runner.output / f"{name}-{index}-junit.xml")
    phase["retained_junit_reports"] = describe(
        runner.output, [f"{name}-{index}-junit.xml" for index in range(len(fresh))]
    )
    runner.save()
    if (
        status
        or not phase["binary_unchanged_after_execution"]
        or not phase["store_config_unchanged_after_execution"]
        or fresh != [store / "default/junit.xml"]
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Migration command failed, executable changed or fresh JUnit is missing"
        )
    copied = runner.output / f"{name}-0-junit.xml"
    phase["junit"] = {"file": copied.name, "sha256": checksum(copied)}
    phase["observed_test"] = parse_phase_junit(copied, name)

        runner.root / RECIPE

        raise ValueError("Old fixture did not use the original Matrix 0.18 packages")

        path.chmod(path.stat().st_mode | 0o200)

        "producer_result_sha256": expected_result,
        "old_source": OLD_SOURCE,
        "driver_source": expected_driver_source,
        "recipe_sha256": record["recipe_sha256"],

        "compiled_source_tree": record["compiled_source_tree"],

    finally:

            "producer_fixture_unchanged_after_reopen"
        ] = unchanged
        runner.record["old_fixture_input"]["files_after_reopen"] = tree_files(working)

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

        final_metadata["resolve"]["nodes"][0]["features"] = features

            nonlocal bazel_updated
            if command[0] == "git":
                return run(label, command, **kwargs)

                (self.root / common.LOCKS[0]).write_text(self.lock)

            patch.object(runner, "run", side_effect=controlled_resolver),

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate or qualify one source-bound dependency port without promotion."""

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

from ndu_port_candidate_common import LOCKS
from ndu_port_candidate_common import POLICIES
from ndu_port_candidate_common import RECIPE
from ndu_port_candidate_common import Recorder
from ndu_port_candidate_common import changed_paths
from ndu_port_candidate_common import check_checkout
from ndu_port_candidate_common import check_toolchain
from ndu_port_candidate_common import checksum
from ndu_port_candidate_common import copy_files
from ndu_port_candidate_common import describe
from ndu_port_candidate_common import load_candidate
from ndu_port_candidate_common import load_recipe
from ndu_port_candidate_common import patch_paths
from ndu_port_candidate_common import restore_candidate
from ndu_port_candidate_common import validate_graph
from ndu_port_candidate_common import verify_tree
from ndu_port_candidate_common import verify_vendor


TEST_GROUPS = {
    "yaml": (
        "codex-utils-yaml",
        "codex-skills",
        "codex-skills-extension",
        "codex-core-plugins",
        "codex-external-agent-migration",
    ),
    "aws": ("codex-aws-auth", "codex-login", "codex-secrets"),
    "keyring": ("codex-keyring-store",),
    "matrix": (
        "codex-hepta-matrix-protocol",
        "codex-hepta-matrix-store",
        "codex-hepta-matrix-sdk",
        "codex-hepta-matrixd",
    ),
}
BAZEL_TARGETS = (
    "//codex-rs/utils/yaml:yaml",
    "//codex-rs/aws-auth:aws-auth",
    "//codex-rs/keyring-store:keyring-store",
    "//codex-rs/hepta-matrix-sdk:hepta-matrix-sdk",
    "//codex-rs/third_party/serde-saphyr-2.0.0:serde-saphyr",
    "//codex-rs/third_party/aws-config-1.8.12:aws-config",
    "//codex-rs/third_party/keyring-3.6.3:keyring",
    "//codex-rs/third_party/secret-service-4.0.0:secret-service",
    "//codex-rs/third_party/matrix-sdk-0.19.1:matrix-sdk",
    "//codex-rs/third_party/matrix-sdk-sqlite-0.19.1:matrix-sdk-sqlite",
)


def generate(runner, expected_source):
    check_checkout(runner, expected_source)
    recipe = load_recipe(runner.root)
    runner.record.update(
        recipe_sha256=checksum(runner.root / RECIPE),
        policy_inputs=describe(runner.root, POLICIES),
        lock_inputs=describe(runner.root, LOCKS),
    )
    shutil.copyfile(runner.root / RECIPE, runner.output / "recipe.json")
    shutil.copyfile(runner.root / recipe["patch_path"], runner.output / "source.patch")
    patch = runner.output / "source.patch"
    if patch_paths(runner, patch) != set(recipe["allowed_paths"]):
        raise ValueError(
            "Source patch path set differs from the exact recipe allowlist"
        )
    runner.run("check-source-patch", ["git", "apply", "--check", "--index", str(patch)])
    runner.run("apply-source-patch", ["git", "apply", "--index", str(patch)])
    fixed_source = describe(runner.root, recipe["allowed_paths"], allow_missing=True)
    verify_vendor(runner.root, recipe)
    check_toolchain(runner, "1.96.0")
    runner.run("bazel-version", ["bazel", "--version"])
    manifest = str(runner.root / "codex-rs/Cargo.toml")
    for index, update in enumerate(recipe["cargo_updates"]):
        command = [
            "cargo",
            "update",
            "--manifest-path",
            manifest,
            "--package",
            update["package"],
        ]
        if "precise" in update:
            command.extend(["--precise", update["precise"]])
        runner.run(f"cargo-update-{index}", command)
    metadata_command = [
        "cargo",
        "metadata",
        "--manifest-path",
        manifest,
        "--locked",
        "--format-version",
        "1",
    ]
    metadata = runner.json_command("metadata-before-bazel", metadata_command)
    validate_graph(runner.root, recipe, metadata)
    runner.run("bazel-lock-update", ["just", "bazel-lock-update"])
    runner.run("bazel-lock-check", ["just", "bazel-lock-check"])
    metadata = runner.json_command("metadata", metadata_command)
    runner.run("diff-check", ["git", "diff", "--check", "HEAD"])
    if (
        describe(runner.root, recipe["allowed_paths"], allow_missing=True)
        != fixed_source
    ):
        raise ValueError("A resolver modified the reviewed source patch")
    validate_graph(runner.root, recipe, metadata)
    changed = changed_paths(runner)
    if not set(recipe["allowed_paths"]) <= changed or not changed <= set(
        (*recipe["allowed_paths"], *LOCKS)
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Resolved candidate differs from the approved source/lock scope"
        )
    inventory = describe(
        runner.root, (*recipe["allowed_paths"], *LOCKS), allow_missing=True
    )
    copy_files(runner.root, runner.output / "files", inventory)
    runner.record.update(files=inventory, changed_paths=sorted(changed))
    verify_tree(runner, runner.record, recipe)
    complete_patch = runner.output / "candidate.patch"
    runner.run(
        "export-candidate-patch",
        [
            "git",
            "diff",
            "--binary",
            "--full-index",
            "--no-renames",
            f"--output={complete_patch}",
            "HEAD",
        ],
    )
    if patch_paths(runner, complete_patch) != changed:
        raise ValueError("Exported complete binary patch has a different file set")
    runner.record.update(
        artifacts=describe(
            runner.output,
            (
                "recipe.json",
                "source.patch",
                "candidate.patch",
                "metadata-before-bazel.json",
                "metadata.json",
            ),
        ),
        status="candidate_generated",
        qualification="Only source/graph/Cargo/Bazel lock generation. Tests, unchanged cargo-deny and platform gates remain separate.",
    )


def junit_inventory(runner):
    directory = Path(
        os.environ.get("CARGO_TARGET_DIR", runner.root / "codex-rs/target")
    )
    if not directory.is_absolute():
        directory = runner.root / "codex-rs" / directory
    return {
        path: (path.stat().st_mtime_ns, checksum(path))
        for path in directory.glob("nextest/*/junit.xml")
    }


def workspace_tests(runner, record, recipe, group):
    runner.run("nextest-version", ["cargo", "nextest", "--version"])
    runner.record.update(test_group=group, test_results=[])
    failures = []
    for package in TEST_GROUPS[group]:
        before = junit_inventory(runner)
        status = runner.run(
            f"test-{package}",
            ["just", "test", "--locked", "--cargo-profile", "ci-test", "-p", package],
            required=False,
        )
        outcome = {
            "package": package,
            "exit_code": status,
            "command_index": len(runner.record["commands"]) - 1,
            "junit": [],
        }
        for path, description in junit_inventory(runner).items():
            if before.get(path) != description:
                target = runner.output / f"{package}-{path.parent.name}-junit.xml"
                shutil.copyfile(path, target)
                outcome["junit"].append(
                    {"file": target.name, "sha256": checksum(target)}
                )
        runner.record["test_results"].append(outcome)
        if status:
            failures.append(package)
        verify_tree(runner, record, recipe)
        runner.save()
    return failures


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--mode",
        choices=("generate", "test", "restore", "verify", "bazel", "upstream-aws"),
        required=True,
    )
    parser.add_argument("--repository", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--candidate", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-result-sha256")

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tomllib
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

SCHEMA = "hepta.ci.matrix-old-fixture.v1"
TEST_PATH = "codex-rs/hepta-matrix-sdk/tests/store_version_migration.rs"
OLD_PACKAGES = ("matrix-sdk", "matrix-sdk-crypto", "matrix-sdk-sqlite")


def verify_old_packages(lock):
    packages = tomllib.loads(lock.read_text())["package"]
    for name in OLD_PACKAGES:
        versions = [row["version"] for row in packages if row["name"] == name]
        if versions != ["0.18.0"]:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Old fixture must resolve exactly {name} 0.18.0, got {versions}"
            )


def parse_phase_junit(path, expected):
    report = ET.parse(path).getroot()
    cases = list(report.iter("testcase"))
    if len(cases) != 1 or cases[0].get("name") != expected:
        raise ValueError("The exact migration test must be the only executed testcase")
    if cases[0].get("classname") != "codex-hepta-matrix-sdk::store_version_migration":
        raise ValueError("Migration testcase came from a different test binary")
    rejected = {
        "failure",
        "error",
        "skipped",
        "flakyFailure",
        "flakyError",
        "rerunFailure",
        "rerunError",
    }
    if any(node.tag in rejected for node in report.iter()):
        raise ValueError("Skipped, failed or retried migration tests are not a pass")
    if report.get("tests") != "1" or any(
        int(report.get(name, "0")) for name in ("failures", "errors", "skipped")
    ):
        raise ValueError("Migration requires one executed pass and no failures/skips")
    return {"name": expected, "executed": 1, "passed": 1, "failed": 0, "skipped": 0}


def run_phase(runner, name, fixture):
    manifest = str(runner.root / "codex-rs/Cargo.toml")
    storage = prepare_nextest_storage(runner)
    selection = [
        "--locked",
        "--cargo-profile",
        "ci-test",
        "-p",
        "codex-hepta-matrix-sdk",
        "--test",
        "store_version_migration",
        "--tool-config-file",
        storage["tool_config_argument"],
    ]
    listing = runner.json_command(
        f"{name}-binaries",
        [
            "cargo",
            "nextest",
            "list",
            "--manifest-path",
            manifest,
            *selection,
            "--list-type",
            "binaries-only",
            "--message-format",
            "json",
        ],
    )
    binaries = list(listing["rust-binaries"].values())
    if (
        len(binaries) != 1
        or binaries[0]["binary-name"] != "store_version_migration"
        or binaries[0]["kind"] != "test"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected exactly the actual migration test executable")
    binary = Path(binaries[0]["binary-path"])
    if binary.is_symlink() or not binary.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Migration executable is not a regular compiled file")
    digest = checksum(binary)
    saved = runner.output / "binaries" / digest
    saved.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(binary, saved)
    if checksum(saved) != digest:
        raise ValueError("Saved executable differs from the compiled binary")
    target = Path(listing["rust-build-meta"]["target-directory"])
    store = Path(storage["directory"])
    reports = lambda: {
        path: (path.stat().st_mtime_ns, checksum(path))
        for path in store.glob("*/junit.xml")
    }
    before = reports()
    status = runner.run(
        name,
        [
            "just",
            "test",
            *selection,
            "--profile",
            "default",
            "--run-ignored",
            "only",
            "-E",
            f"test(={name})",
            "--retries",
            "0",
            "--no-tests",
            "fail",
        ],
        required=False,
        environment={"HEPTA_MATRIX_MIGRATION_FIXTURE": str(fixture.resolve())},
    )
    phase = {
        "name": name,
        "exit_code": status,
        "binary": str(saved.relative_to(runner.output)),
        "binary_sha256": digest,
        "binary_original_path": str(binary),
        "binary_unchanged_after_execution": checksum(binary) == digest,
        "command_index": len(runner.record["commands"]) - 1,
        "nextest_storage": storage,
        "cargo_target_directory": str(target),
        "store_config_unchanged_after_execution": describe(
            runner.output, (storage["config_file"],)
        )[storage["config_file"]]
        == storage["config"],
    }
    runner.record["migration_phase"] = phase
    fresh = [path for path, value in reports().items() if before.get(path) != value]
    phase["fresh_junit_count"] = len(fresh)
    phase["observed_junit_paths"] = [str(path) for path in fresh]
    for index, path in enumerate(fresh):
        shutil.copyfile(path, runner.output / f"{name}-{index}-junit.xml")
    phase["retained_junit_reports"] = describe(
        runner.output, [f"{name}-{index}-junit.xml" for index in range(len(fresh))]
    )
    runner.save()
    if (
        status
        or not phase["binary_unchanged_after_execution"]
        or not phase["store_config_unchanged_after_execution"]
        or fresh != [store / "default/junit.xml"]
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Migration command failed, executable changed or fresh JUnit is missing"
        )
    copied = runner.output / f"{name}-0-junit.xml"
    phase["junit"] = {"file": copied.name, "sha256": checksum(copied)}
    phase["observed_test"] = parse_phase_junit(copied, name)
    runner.save()
    return phase


def produce_old_fixture(runner, driver_root, driver_source):

        driver_source_commit=driver_source,

    frozen_lock = describe(runner.root, ("codex-rs/Cargo.lock",))
    copy_files(runner.root, runner.output / "original-files", frozen_lock)

    if patch_paths(runner, patch) != {TEST_PATH}:

    )

def consume_old_fixture(
    runner, recipe, artifact, expected_result, expected_driver_source
):
    if checksum(artifact / "RESULT.json") != expected_result:
        raise ValueError("Old fixture RESULT differs from the producer job hash")
    record = json.loads((artifact / "RESULT.json").read_text())
    if (
        record.get("schema") != SCHEMA
        or record.get("status") != "old_fixture_generated"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Artifact is not a successful independent old fixture")
    if (
        record["source_commit"] != OLD_SOURCE
        or record["driver_source_commit"] != expected_driver_source
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Old fixture source/driver differs from the fixed independent sources"
        )
    if record["toolchain"] != "1.95.0" or record["recipe_sha256"] != checksum(
        runner.root / RECIPE
    ):
        raise ValueError("Old fixture compiler or recipe differs")
    if record["baseline_versions"] != {name: "0.18.0" for name in OLD_PACKAGES}:
        raise ValueError("Old fixture did not use the original Matrix 0.18 packages")
    for key in ("github_run_id", "github_run_attempt"):
        if os.environ.get(key.upper()) and record.get(key) != os.environ[key.upper()]:
            raise ValueError("Old fixture came from another workflow run/attempt")
    if describe(artifact, record["artifacts"]) != record["artifacts"]:
        raise ValueError("Old source/lock/binary/artifact bytes differ")
    if (
        record["artifacts"]["fixture-only.patch"]["sha256"]
        != recipe["matrix_baseline"]["fixture_patch_sha256"]
    ):
        raise ValueError("Old fixture patch differs from the reviewed patch")
    verify_old_packages(artifact / "original-files/codex-rs/Cargo.lock")
    phase = record["migration_phase"]
    if phase["exit_code"] != 0 or phase["binary_unchanged_after_execution"] is not True:
        raise ValueError("Old producer did not retain a successful actual executable")
    parse_phase_junit(artifact / phase["junit"]["file"], "prepare_old_version_fixture")
    original = artifact / "fixture"
    if tree_files(original) != record["fixture_files"]:
        raise ValueError("Old database file set or bytes differ from the producer")
    working = runner.output / "writable-old-fixture"
    shutil.copytree(original, working)
    if tree_files(working) != record["fixture_files"]:
        raise ValueError("The independent writable copy differs before migration")
    for path in (original, *original.rglob("*")):
        path.chmod(path.stat().st_mode & ~0o222)
    working.chmod(working.stat().st_mode | 0o200)
    for path in working.rglob("*"):
        path.chmod(path.stat().st_mode | 0o200)
    runner.record["old_fixture_input"] = {
        "producer_result_sha256": expected_result,
        "old_source": OLD_SOURCE,
        "driver_source": expected_driver_source,
        "recipe_sha256": record["recipe_sha256"],
        "files_before_reopen": record["fixture_files"],
        "compiled_source_tree": record["compiled_source_tree"],
        "producer_binary_sha256": phase["binary_sha256"],
    }
    try:
        run_phase(runner, "reopen_old_version_fixture", working)
    finally:
        unchanged = tree_files(original) == record["fixture_files"]
        runner.record["old_fixture_input"][
            "producer_fixture_unchanged_after_reopen"
        ] = unchanged
        runner.record["old_fixture_input"]["files_after_reopen"] = tree_files(working)
        runner.save()
        if not unchanged:
            raise ValueError("Consumer changed the preserved original old fixture")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repository", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--driver-repository", type=Path, required=True)

        self.policy = common.describe(self.root, common.POLICIES)

        self.lock = 'version = 4\n[[package]]\nname = "example"\nversion = "1.0.0"\n'
        (self.root / common.LOCKS[0]).write_text(self.lock)
        (self.root / common.LOCKS[1]).write_text("candidate Bazel lock\n")
        self.artifact = self.base / "artifact"
        self.artifact.mkdir()
        shutil.copyfile(recipe_path, self.artifact / "recipe.json")
        shutil.copyfile(self.root / self.patch_name, self.artifact / "source.patch")
        self.metadata = {
            "workspace_root": str(self.root / "codex-rs"),
            "packages": [
                {
                    "name": "example",
                    "version": "1.0.0",
                    "id": "example-id",
                    "source": None,
                    "manifest_path": str(self.root / self.vendor / "Cargo.toml"),
                }
            ],
            "resolve": {"nodes": [{"id": "example-id", "features": ["crypto"]}]},
        }
        (self.artifact / "metadata.json").write_text(json.dumps(self.metadata))
        git(
            self.root,

            "--binary",
            "--full-index",
            "--no-renames",
            f"--output={self.artifact / 'candidate.patch'}",
            "HEAD",
        )
        inventory = common.describe(
            self.root, (*self.recipe["allowed_paths"], *common.LOCKS)
        )
        common.copy_files(self.root, self.artifact / "files", inventory)
        self.record = {
            "schema": common.SCHEMA,
            "status": "candidate_generated",
            "source_commit": self.source,
            "original_dependency_policy_unchanged": True,
            "policy_inputs": self.policy,
            "recipe_sha256": common.checksum(recipe_path),

            "changed_paths": sorted(inventory),
            "github_run_id": os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID"),
            "github_run_attempt": os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"),
            "artifacts": common.describe(
                self.artifact,
                ("recipe.json", "source.patch", "candidate.patch", "metadata.json"),
            ),
        }
        self.seal()
        git(self.root, "reset", "--hard", "HEAD")

    def seal(self):
        (self.artifact / "RESULT.json").write_text(json.dumps(self.record))
        self.result_sha = common.checksum(self.artifact / "RESULT.json")

    def runner(self, name="run"):
        return common.Recorder(self.root, self.base / name, "test")

    def restore(self, runner):
        return common.restore_candidate(
            runner, self.artifact, self.result_sha, self.source
        )

    def generate_with_final_features(self, features):
        """Use real Git/process evidence with controlled external resolver results."""
        runner = self.runner("generate")
        run = runner.run
        final_metadata = copy.deepcopy(self.metadata)
        final_metadata["resolve"]["nodes"][0]["features"] = features
        bazel_updated = False

        def controlled_resolver(label, command, **kwargs):
            nonlocal bazel_updated
            if command[0] == "git":
                return run(label, command, **kwargs)
            if command[:2] == ["cargo", "update"]:
                (self.root / common.LOCKS[0]).write_text(self.lock)
            elif command[:2] == ["cargo", "metadata"]:
                metadata = final_metadata if bazel_updated else self.metadata
                return run(
                    label,
                    [
                        sys.executable,
                        "-c",
                        "import sys; print(sys.argv[1])",
                        json.dumps(metadata),
                    ],
                    **kwargs,
                )
            elif command == ["just", "bazel-lock-update"]:
                bazel_updated = True
                (self.root / common.LOCKS[1]).write_text("resolved Bazel lock\n")
            elif command not in (["just", "bazel-lock-check"], ["bazel", "--version"]):
                raise AssertionError(f"Unexpected resolver command: {command}")
            return run(
                label,
                [sys.executable, "-c", "print('controlled resolver completed')"],
                **kwargs,
            )

        with (
            patch.object(candidate, "check_toolchain"),
            patch.object(runner, "run", side_effect=controlled_resolver),
        ):
            candidate.generate(runner, self.source)
        return runner, final_metadata

        runner, final_metadata = self.generate_with_final_features(

        )
        self.assertEqual(
